evidence.paraphrase: Context tokens (C) and query tokens (Q) inside a diffusion transformer; predicted video latent tokens (P). query tokens adaptively extract useful information from context tokens; P tokens condition on Q tokens during generation.

During operation, MemLearner applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to scene and object continuity needed for revisits under occlusion and dynamic objects; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): The carried memory grows chunk by chunk during long-video inference; the update rule is fixed, so this is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
